title: Kyuubiki operator task batch resume plan

recovery_evidence_verified.description: Execution recovery evidence is internally consistent. This does not certify provenance, numerical accuracy or automatic continuation. False also covers checkpoints without execution.

automatic_replay_allowed.description: A resume plan is advice only, never permission to silently replay work.

retryable_case_ids.description: Verified failures whose receipt allows explicit retry. The original attempt and current ownership must still be reconciled; continuation_blocked may remain true.

repair_required_case_ids.description: Verified nonretryable failures requiring repair before a fresh submission. Unverified failures do not populate this list.

continuation_blocked.description: True when failure receipts prohibit continuing other tasks or execution recovery is unverified. False is not dispatch permission; the policy, readiness, original attempt and ownership still apply.
